Act13-2#1.zh: 刚刚那一批人已被我们打跑，短期内可能不会追来...
Act13-2#1.t: We drove off that last lot. They probably won't come after us for a while...

Act13-2#2.zh: 无妨！只要逃到这里就没问题了！
Act13-2#2.t: No matter! Once we get here we're safe!

Act13-2#3.zh: 没问题？这里四周都是与人等高的芦苇，我看我们会先在里面迷路！
Act13-2#3.t: Safe? There are reeds as tall as a man all around. I think we'll get lost in here first!

Act13-2#4.zh: 教头有所不知。这里名叫蓼儿洼，我们三兄弟住的石碣村就在附近。也就是说，这个蓼儿洼等于是我家的后院。哪里有深渊、哪里可以埋伏，没有人比我们兄弟更了解！
Act13-2#4.t: You don't know this place, Instructor. It's called Liao'er Hollow, and Stone Tablet Village, where we three brothers live, is close by. This hollow is basically our back yard. Where the deep water is, where to lie in ambush: nobody knows it better than us!

Act13-2#5.zh: 这里如果知道地形的话，真的是不错的埋伏地点...
Act13-2#5.t: If you know the lie of the land, it really is a fine place for an ambush...

Act13-2#6.zh: 二郎！你是干了什么事啊？有许多官兵跟着你们后面追过来啦！带头的何观察还直向我们问说有没有看到晁盖、阮氏三兄弟的人影...
Act13-2#6.t: Second Brother! What have you done? A lot of soldiers are on your trail! Inspector He at their head kept asking us whether we'd seen Chao Gai or the three Ruan brothers...

Act13-2#7.zh: 不要慌；我们三个就足以对付他们！让他们大半下水淹死、小半被刀戳死！
Act13-2#7.t: Don't panic. The three of us are enough for them! Most of them will drown and the rest we'll stick with our knives!

Act13-2#8.zh: %X兄，以兵法上来说，奇袭总是最好的办法；敌人虽然人多势众，但是我们可占了天时、地利、人和；此战必胜！
Act13-2#8.t: Brother %X, in the art of war a surprise attack is always best. The enemy has numbers, but we have the timing, the ground and the people on our side. We're sure to win!

Act13-2#9.zh: 也好！我们就在这里给他们来个迎头痛击！
Act13-2#9.t: Good! We'll give them a crushing blow right here!

Act13-2#10.zh: 孙二，事情紧急！你快去村子里找些人来帮忙！拜托你了！
Act13-2#10.t: Sun Er, it's urgent! Run to the village and find some people to help! I'm counting on you!

Act13-2#12.t: The Ruan brothers lay a trap in Liao'er Hollow.
